lina_finance: FYI CloudHarbor contacted us claiming they were double-billed for April marketplace usage (subscription 4443332221). They say AWS charged marketplace meter and Redwood also issued a separate invoice for same units.

oscar_sales: Which invoice number and amount? Is customer impacted or just partner settlement flow?

sam_cloudharbor: attached AWS invoice and our statement: https://files.cloudharbor.io/invoices/apr-4443332221.pdf. They point to line item of 152,000 tokens. CloudHarbor was charged by AWS but also received invoice RD-5553 from Redwood for $228.00.

billing-bot: :mag_right: Duplicate billing alert for subscription 4443332221. Marketplace metering matches platform ledger for April 2026.

jess_ops: Investigated. Migration script GH-523 reset reseller_mode flag on 2026-04-01 causing partner_forwarded events to be ingested as billable. Snippet:

```
aws_meter: 2026-04-12, sub 4443332221, redwood.tokens.marketplace, 152000
platform_ledger: 2026-04-12, sub 4443332221, partner_forwarded.tokens, 152000
```

lina_finance: Root cause found. We need to quantify exposure and remediate: refund partner and reprocess settlements.

marta_legal: Contract: reseller_mode accounts should not be invoiced directly. We must notify partner and correct records. I'll draft notice.

oscar_sales: Recommend refund $228 + $50 goodwill credit. Sam, will partner accept that?

sam_cloudharbor: yes please refund to CH-ACCT-77. The partner accepts goodwill credit. They'll need settlement CSV for accounting.

jess_ops: I'll patch GH-523 and reprocess April settlements immediately, upload reprocessed CSV.

lina_finance: Approved to issue refund $278 total (228 + 50). Lina to create refund txn, Jess to provide reprocess CSV, Marta to send legal notice. Target 48h.

billing-bot: action_required: refund_created by lina_finance amount 278.00 status pending.

oscar_sales: Thanks team. Sam, we'll share the settlement note once legal finalizes.

sam_cloudharbor: appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll confirm when refund applied. :handshake:
